comment: Runtime settings (docs/BLE.md §B3). Source of truth for firmware/src/settings_gen.h (tools/gen_settings.mjs) and the config page. Keys <= 15 chars (NVS). default.macro is the config.h macro the firmware uses; default.value is the same value for the page and tests.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.help: Night brightness level (0.55 = default). The LDR scales it down further on very dark nights.

settings.label: Follow swarm brightness
settings.help: On: this unit uses the brightness set for the whole swarm. Off: it keeps its own brightness.

settings.label: Eye spacing
settings.help: Centre-to-centre distance of the two displays. Used for vergence and the scanner sweep.

settings.label: Always on
settings.help: Off (Auto): the show starts at dusk and runs for the show hours. On (Always): it runs whenever it is awake.

settings.label: Show hours
settings.help: How long the show runs after dusk.

settings.label: Dusk threshold
settings.help: Light reading below which it counts as dark enough to start. Lower = later start.

settings.label: Daylight threshold
settings.help: Light reading above which it counts as daylight. Must be at least 250 mV above dusk.

settings.label: Darkest-night reading
settings.help: Light reading at which brightness reaches its minimum (65 %). Must be below dusk.

settings.label: Motion startle
settings.help: Let the PIR sensor startle the eyes. Turn off if it false-triggers in the bush.

settings.label: Battery calibration
settings.help: Multiply the battery reading by this. Calibrate at 3.8 V against a meter.

settings.label: Styles in the shuffle
settings.help: Which styles the show picks from. Turning off hellfire also turns off the jump-scare.

settings.label: Pinned at boot
settings.help: Always show this style (empty = shuffle). The BOOT long press still pins and unpins for now.

settings.label: Left eye rotation
settings.help: Quarter turns. Use the test card: the arrow must point up.

settings.label: Right eye rotation
settings.help: Quarter turns. Use the test card: the arrow must point up.

settings.label: Left eye mirror
settings.help: Set if the test card's dot is on the left.

settings.label: Right eye mirror
settings.help: Set if the test card's dot is on the left.

settings.label: BGR colour order
settings.help: Flip if red and blue are swapped on the test card.

settings.label: Left eye invert
settings.help: Clear if the test card shows negative colours (cyan top half).

settings.label: Right eye invert
settings.help: Clear if the test card shows negative colours (cyan top half).

settings.label: Bluetooth name
settings.help: Shown when connecting (empty = HE- plus the last 4 digits of the MAC address).

settings.label: Bluetooth window
settings.help: Seconds the unit stays connectable after a boot (0 = always). Press RESET to reopen it.

settings.label: PIN
settings.help: 0 = no PIN. With a PIN, a phone must enter it before it can change anything.

settings.label: Follow swarm PIN
settings.help: On: this unit uses the PIN set for the whole swarm. Off: it keeps its own PIN.
